Botanica Verdant

Villa in Nai Thon (Thalang)
HomeSaleBotanica Verdant

Project overview

Marketed as Botanica The Verdant (The Verdant by Botanica), a villa community by Botanica Luxury Phuket, the developer of the Botanica villa estates. It is under construction and one of the advertised homes is a furnished three-bedroom, three-bathroom pool villa of 147 sqm on leasehold title, from THB 15.9 million.

Listings place the project at Nai Thon in Thalang, while another says it is central to Phuket; the exact site is not confirmed here. Descriptions mention landscaped walking paths, children playgrounds, sports courts, barbecue areas and controlled access, but these are promotional and not a verified facilities list.

A listing site also quotes plots of 305-469 sqm and a fourth-quarter 2026 completion; neither is confirmed by a second source, so ask the developer for the master plan and schedule.

Botanica Verdant: key facts

  • Botanica Verdant is a pool villa in Nai Thon, Phuket, developed by Botanica Luxury Phuket Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 3 bedrooms, 147 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿15,900,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Phuket International Airport (13 minutes, driving); Nai Yang Beach (12 minutes, driving); Thalang Hospital (10 minutes, driving); Lotus's Supercenter Thalang (11 minutes, driving).
  • More projects by Botanica Luxury Phuket in our catalogue: Botanica Modern Sea Karon, Botanica MontAzure, Botanica Skyport, HYTHE by Botanica.
